diagnostics.message: aws_launch_template.this orders itself after aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this (to ensure node IAM policies exist before nodes launch from the template), but it does not depend on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional. Any user-supplied `iam_role_additional_policies` are therefore not guaranteed to be attached before the EKS managed node group launches instances, and EKS may mis-handle creation/deletion of instances whose role is missing those permissions. Add the additional attachment to the launch template's `depends_on`.

aws_launch_template.this depends on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this so the node role's managed policies exist before instances launch, but it omits aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional. The user-supplied `iam_role_additional_policies` can therefore still be missing when the self-managed autoscaling group boots nodes, causing instances that require those permissions to fail to come up. Add the additional attachment to the launch template's `depends_on`.
